display.purpose: The name only (and the footer's closing line at clamp(2rem, 6vw, 4.5rem)); wide, extra-bold, followed by the block cursor; animates its axes once on boot.

headline.purpose: Page headers: warn three-digit address plus uppercase wide title; 1.875rem below sm.

title.purpose: Service names in mono bold; turns warn on row hover.

body.purpose: Row descriptions and bullets, max 68ch; secondary sentences in dim.

readout.purpose: Action commands and the hero role/qualification line (0.75rem mobile, 0.875rem from sm, uppercase there).

label.purpose: Status bar, log tail lines, metric figures.

label-micro.purpose: Axis years, date ranges, skill chips, host names, footer line; usually uppercase.

utilities.name: greenbar
utilities.purpose: Printout bands on rows of records; --band is transparent in the console.

utilities.name: condensed

focus.purpose: Global :focus-visible ring; selection and caret also use warn.

motion.name: ease-signal

motion.name: signal-lock
motion.purpose: Name axis sweep, once on load.

motion.name: type-in
motion.purpose: Boot-log lines, staggered 110ms after a 500ms delay.

components.name: Page Header

components.css: .ds-pagehead { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px 24px; border-top: 2px solid var(--ink); padding-top: 16px; font-family: 'Martian Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; color: var(--ink); } .ds-pagehead h2 { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.5em; margin: 0; font-size: 3rem; line-height: 1; font-weight: 800; font-stretch: 112.5%; letter-spacing: -0.025em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-pagehead h2 span { color: var(--warn); } .ds-pagehead p { margin: 0; font-size: 0.75rem; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--dim); }

components.name: Log Tail Panel
components.description: The only panel surface: ruled caption with square heartbeat, log lines on a 5ch grid.
components.css: .ds-log { margin: 0; border: 1px solid var(--rule); background: var(--panel); color: var(--ink); font-family: 'Martian Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.7rem; line-height: 1.625; border-radius: 0; } .ds-log figcaption { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); padding: 8px 16px; color: var(--dim); } .ds-live { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ok); } .ds-live i { width: 6px; height: 6px; background: var(--ok); animation: ds-beat 2.4s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-log ol { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 16px; display: grid; gap: 6px; } .ds-log li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 5ch 5ch minmax(0,1fr); column-gap: 8px; } .ds-log time { color: var(--dim); } .ds-info { color: var(--info); } .ds-ok { color: var(--ok); } .ds-cursor { display: inline-block; width: 0.5em; height: 0.78em; margin-left: 0.1em; background: var(--warn); animation: ds-blink 1.1s steps(1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-beat { 50% { opacity: 0.45; } } @keyframes ds-blink { 50% { opacity: 0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-live i, .ds-cursor { animation: none; } }

components.html: NearformSenior Software Engineer
components.css: .ds-span { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 19rem minmax(0,1fr); align-items: center; column-gap: 32px; padding: 16px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); color: var(--ink); font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-span b { display: block; font-weight: 600; } .ds-span small { display: block; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--dim); } .ds-axis { position: relative; display: block; height: 28px; } .ds-range { position: absolute; top: -8px; bottom: -8px; border-left: 1px solid var(--warn); border-right: 1px solid var(--warn); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--warn) 10%, transparent); opacity: 0; transition: opacity 150ms; } .ds-bar { position: absolute; top: 50%; height: 12px; transform: translateY(-50%); background: var(--info); transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-bar.ds-current { background: var(--ok); } .ds-span:hover { background: var(--panel); } .ds-span:hover .ds-range { opacity: 1; } .ds-span:hover .ds-bar { background: var(--warn); }

narrative.overview:
The CV is a production service that has been up since 2003, and the page is its operator's console: a status bar, then broadcast pages addressed 100 to 500 (status, traces, metrics, services, logs). Everything that is a fact (a year, a level, a name, a command) is set as a monospaced readout; only sentences fall back to a grotesque. Surfaces are flat panels divided by hairline rules on a character-unit grid, and colour is a fixed signal vocabulary rather than decoration.

The dark theme ("crt", the default `:root`) is a control room at night: an ink ground tinted from the Palettebro teal. The light theme ("print") is not a lightened screen but a different physical medium, continuous green-bar fanfold printout: pale paper, mint bands that follow the printed data rows, and tractor-feed hole margins on wide screens. Both themes share every token name; only the values move.

Density is that of a working instrument: tight label sizes, tabular figures, wide gutters between pages. The single expressive gesture is the boot: the name's width and weight axes sweep from condensed hairline to wide heavy as the signal locks, and the career log types in line by line. After that, only the clock, the cursor and the heartbeat move. No glow, no scanlines, no glass.
keyCharacteristics: Two themes, one token set: console (dark) and green-bar printout (light).
Fixed signal palette, one job per colour: OK, INFO, WARN.
Martian Mono for every readout, variable `wdth` and `wght`; Hanken Grotesk for prose only.
Three-digit page addresses as navigation, keyboard keys 1-5.
Flat panels, hairline rules, square corners, square status dots.
Boot once on load, then still; reduced motion shows the final state.

rules.name: The One Job Rule
rules.body: OK means healthy or current, INFO means past or informational, WARN means "look here". A colour never borrows another's meaning, and none of them is used as a decorative fill.

rules.name: The Amber Is The Operator Rule
rules.body: Every interactive affordance resolves to warn on hover or focus. If an element turns amber, it can be acted on; if it cannot be acted on, it does not turn amber (the page-address numerals are the one static use, because they are the navigation).

rules.name: The Readout Rule
rules.body: If it is a number, a date, a status, a command, a name or a label, it is Martian Mono. Hanken Grotesk is reserved for sentences a person would read aloud.

rules.name: The Width Is Rank Rule
rules.body: Display and headline text is set wide (`wdth` 112.5%) and extra-bold; small mono stays at normal width. Width, not colour, signals hierarchy in the monospace.

rules.name: The Signal Lock Rule
rules.body: The name's axes animate exactly once: `wght` 100 → 800 and `wdth` 75% → 112.5% with tracking 0.12em → -0.02em over 1.6s on `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`. No other text animates its axes.

rules.name: The Green-Bar Rule
rules.body: Bands follow the printed data rows: any list or table body of records gets the `greenbar` treatment (odd children filled with `--band`). Bands are invisible in the console, so the structure costs nothing in dark.

rules.name: The No-Glow Rule
rules.body: No shadows, glows, scanlines, blur or glass in either theme. A console screen here is lit flat; a printout is paper. Separation comes from a 1px rule or a tonal step.

dos: Do define every new colour as a theme pair on the shared role names (`--ground`, `--panel`, `--rule`, `--ink`, `--dim`, `--ok`, `--info`, `--warn`) so both console and printout get it.
Do give each new section a three-digit page address in warn, a Page Header, and a number key.
Do set every figure, date, status and label in Martian Mono with tabular numerals.
Do apply `greenbar` to any list or table of records.
Do resolve hover and focus to warn (2px warn outline, 3px offset for focus).
Do keep motion to the boot sequence, the clock, the cursor blink and the heartbeat, and show the final state under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Do use the `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` ease-out for any reveal.
donts: Don't add shadows, glows, scanlines, blur or glassy surfaces in either theme.
Don't round corners or use circular status dots; indicators are squares.
Don't use ok, info or warn as decoration or outside their single meaning.
Don't set prose in the monospace or readouts in Hanken Grotesk.
Don't animate font axes on anything except the name's single boot sweep.
Don't treat the light theme as an inverted screen; it is paper with bands and tractor-feed margins.
